summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Netor exam-prep platform. Backend: created pytest suite (54 tests) covering auth (register/login/me/lockout/profile), exam hierarchy, question bank + filters + practice answering, deneme start/submit/scoring/results, dashboard/proficiency/leaderboard analytics and admin RBAC/CRUD — 54/54 pass. Frontend: verified landing, register, login, dashboard, exam selection persistence, question bank (answer feedback, filters, pagination), full deneme flow (timer countdown, option select, prev/next, mark, question list jump, submit -> result page with correct score 62.5 for net 1.25/10), eksiklerim, siralama tabs, AI Koc, profile edit+save, logout + protected-route redirect, admin panel as admin, mobile bottom nav with zero horizontal overflow. No console/page errors anywhere. Core product works end-to-end; only minor issues found.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout key is f"{request.client.host}:{email}". Behind the k8s ingress request.client.host is the proxy pod IP and rotates between replicas (observed 10.208.135.204 / .205), so attempt counters split and lockout only fires after ~11 failures instead of 5. Key on email (and/or X-Forwarded-For first hop) instead.

allow_origins=["*"] combined with allow_credentials=True is rejected by browsers for credentialed requests, and the CORS_ORIGINS env var is defined in backend/.env but never used. httpOnly cookies set by login therefore cannot work cross-origin (app happens to work only because the frontend uses the Bearer token). Use explicit origins from CORS_ORIGINS.
Every page visit creates a new test_session row; abandoned sessions are never expired/cleaned up (grows unbounded).

exam_id/subject_id/topic_id are not validated against existing docs — bulk insert with subject_id='s1', topic_id='t1' succeeded, creating orphan questions that later show as topic_name 'Bilinmeyen' in proficiency.
status/result filters load the user's entire user_answers collection into memory (to_list(100000)) on every request; same in /dashboard and /topics/proficiency. Will not scale.

ui_bugs.issue: Series returns 7 points but only 6 x-axis labels render (16.08 tick missing / clipped) — chart appears to show 6 days.
Bitir (submit-exam) submits immediately with no confirmation dialog even with unanswered questions — easy accidental submit.

issues: Native browser <select> elements used for exam/subject/result/exam-filter instead of the shadcn Select component used elsewhere — inconsistent styling with the rest of the UI
Leaderboard rows have no data-testid (only lb-period-*/lb-metric-*/lb-exam), so row/rank assertions are not possible
Dashboard.jsx has zero data-testid attributes — key metrics (solved_today, avg_score, overall_success) cannot be asserted reliably
Result page score/correct/wrong/blank/net values have no data-testid
QuestionBank option testids are dynamic (qb-{uuid}-opt-A) while ExamPlayer uses option-A..E; a stable pattern would help

action_items: Fix login lockout keying (use email, not proxy client IP) so 5-attempt lockout actually triggers at 5.
Replace CORS allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True with explicit origins from CORS_ORIGINS env.
Validate exam_id/subject_id/topic_id references in admin question/subject/topic creation endpoints.
Render all 7 ticks in the dashboard 7-day chart (or label it as 6 days).
Add data-testid to Dashboard metrics, Result values and Leaderboard rows.
Optional: add confirm step before Bitir when questions are unanswered; clean up abandoned test_sessions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 738 lines and mixes auth, content, analytics and admin routers — split into routers/ modules before it grows further.
Analytics endpoints re-read all of user_answers per request (to_list(100000)); move aggregation to MongoDB aggregation pipelines.

auth.py set_auth_cookies is called on login/register but never actually used by the frontend (Bearer only) while CORS wildcard makes them unusable — either finish the cookie flow with explicit origins or drop it.
Login lockout writes locked_until on the first failure but the gate is count>=5; combined with the rotating proxy IP the security control is effectively unreliable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows functional (minor cosmetic/testability issues only)

All flows verified working as of this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: Lockout failure RCA: db.login_attempts documents are keyed by '{proxy_pod_ip}:{email}'; the preview ingress has multiple proxy pods so consecutive failed logins land on different identifiers, splitting the counter. Reproduce: POST /api/auth/login with a wrong password ~11 times for one email and inspect login_attempts — two docs appear with counts summing to the attempts. Mitigation: key the lockout document on the normalized email only.
